2609.15022.title: SALUTE: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for the Defense Domain
2609.15022.paper_summary: Defense is a knowledge-intensive domain that requires precise understanding of specialized terminology, doctrinal concepts, operational procedures, and evolving military events. Although recent work has explored language technologies for military applications, existing efforts remain fragmented: they are often task-specific, rely on limited adaptation pipelines, or lack comprehensive defense-domain evaluation. In this paper, we present SALUTE, an end-to-end framework for benchmarking and adapting LLMs for the defense domain. SALUTE integrates Salute-Corpus, a curated corpus from open-access U.S. military doctrine and government documents; Salute-Conv, a grounded instruction dataset from doctrinal sources and decade-long defense news; Salute-Pref, a defense-aware preference dataset; and Salute-Bench, a rigorously filtered benchmark for evaluating defense-domain understanding and reasoning over doctrine and defense news. Based on these resources, we train Salute-LLM through multi-stage post-training with continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and preference alignment. Extensive experiments show that Salute-LLM achieves strong defense-domain performance while retaining competitive general capabilities, demonstrating the effectiveness of SALUTE as an end-to-end framework for defense-domain LLM adaptation.
2609.15022.paper_summary_zh: 防禦是一個知識密集的領域，需要對專業術語、教義概念、操作程序和不斷演變的軍事事件有精確的理解。雖然最近的研究已探討軍事應用的語言技術，但現有的努力仍然是零散的：它們通常是針對特定任務的，依賴於有限的適應流程，或缺乏全面的防禦領域評估。在本文中，我們提出了SALUTE，一個用於基準測試和適應大型語言模型（LLMs）以應用於防禦領域的端到端框架。SALUTE整合了Salute-Corpus，一個來自美國軍事教義和政府文件的精選語料庫；Salute-Conv，一個來自教義來源和十年防禦新聞的基礎指令數據集；Salute-Pref，一個防禦意識的偏好數據集；以及Salute-Bench，一個經過嚴格篩選的基準，用於評估對教義和防禦新聞的理解和推理。基於這些資源，我們通過多階段的後訓練，持續預訓練、監督微調和偏好對齊來訓練Salute-LLM。大量實驗顯示，Salute-LLM在防禦領域表現出色，同時保持競爭性的通用能力，展示了SALUTE作為防禦領域LLM適應的端到端框架的有效性。
